## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link related issues.

## ANS behavior and compatibility

Identify relevant specification sections, affected methods/deployment paths,
and any migration or configuration requirements.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Distinguish unit tests,
synthetic integration tests and live registry/TL evidence. State failures,
untested paths and remaining release blockers.

## Contribution checklist

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [DCO](../DCO).
- [ ] My contribution commits contain my `Signed-off-by:` attestation.
- [ ] Required copyright and license notices are preserved.
- [ ] The change contains no live credentials, private keys or authenticated proofs.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated.

## AI assistance

State `None` or disclose the tool and model, for example:

`Assisted-by: <tool> (<model>)`

The human submitter remains responsible for the contribution and DCO sign-off.
Do not add AI authors or AI `Co-Authored-By:` trailers.
